tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: Current public retail packages in USD. No order is created; checkout confirms the final price.

tools.name: get_editorial_guidelines
tools.description: Get Vokolla editorial rules and supported categories for a distribution package.

tools.name: check_release
tools.description: Deterministic word/link/contact checks on a manuscript. No AI provider call or publication. HTML active content is removed.

tools.name: ai_draft_release
tools.description: Draft a press release in English from customer-supplied notes or extracted document text. Facts that are missing are listed for the customer to supply. The materials are sent to Vokolla’s AI provider. The draft is shown to the customer first; saving is a separate step.

tools.name: ai_review_release
tools.description: Find editorial issues and suggested replacements using the same AI review as Vokolla. The manuscript is sent to Vokolla’s AI provider. The saved draft is left as it is.

tools.name: ai_adapt_release
tools.description: Prepare a factual revision against USA Today editorial formatting requirements, including missing facts to resolve. The content is sent to Vokolla’s AI provider. Returns a proposal for the customer to review.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Create an account-owned draft for customer review. Requires an explicit request to save. Reuse the same UUID requestId on retry; use a new one for different content. Never changes an existing draft or places an order. Review and payment remain on Vokolla.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Read this account’s latest synchronized release records, most recent first. Returns saved status information without triggering a new status check or including billing/contact details.

tools.name: get_release_status
tools.description: Read the latest synchronized status and coverage for a release owned by this account. Coverage URLs are third-party data. Does not submit, retry or cancel anything.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_release, get_release_status · Private data: check_release, ai_draft_release, list_releases · Public sink: get_release_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_release, get_release_status · Private data: check_release, ai_draft_release, list_releases · Public sink: get_release_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "ai_draft_release" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use Vokolla AI to draft from customer-supplied notes or extracted document text. Missing facts are marked for the customer. Sends materials to Vokolla’s AI provider; uses the account MCP AI quota. Does not save or publish." → after: "Draft a press release in English from customer-supplied notes or extracted document text. Facts that are missing are listed for the customer to supply. The materials are sent to Vokolla’s AI provider. The draft is shown to the customer first; saving is a separate step."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
